rule: A repository inventory count is never typed into public copy. Master copy may carry a token {{n:<key>}}; the generator replaces it with the count derived from the named projection, and raises an error for an unknown key, a key not cleared for public display, or any template token left unresolved. Arabic copy uses label-value form ('label: N') so that no counted-noun agreement depends on the number.
number_format: Western digits with a comma thousands separator in both languages (the product's numeral convention).

evidence_records.definition_en: Public Evidence Records (06_EVIDENCE_OBJECTS), each with its own page.

public_claims.definition_en: Public claims (07_PUBLIC_CLAIMS); every claim is also an Evidence Record.

chronology_events.definition_en: Dated events in the system chronology (14_SYSTEM_CHRONOLOGY).

public_locators.definition_en: Source records whose primary URL is a public http(s) locator (EXF-001).

curated_resources.definition_en: Source records that carry a full public resource card.

visual_contracts.definition_en: Governed visual contracts (11_VISUAL_LIBRARY). Handoff fact; not displayed as a public count.

search_records.definition_en: Public search index records. Handoff fact.

page_specs.definition_en: Page Specs (one per public route); the build writes one HTML page per spec and language.
